name: ai-art-classroom
description: AI绘画小课堂 - 学校AI绘画工具

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm install && npx vite build
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm install && npx tsc
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npx electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npx electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:all: npm run build && npx electron-builder --mac --win --config electron-builder.yml
